examples.ko: 호수 위에 하얀 백조가 떠 있어요.
examples.en: A white swan is floating on the lake.
Swans move to warmer places in winter.
The kids tried to give bread to the swan.
I played the role of the swan in the ballet performance.

examples.ko: 백조 한 쌍이 물가를 천천히 걸었어요.
examples.en: A pair of swans walked slowly along the water's edge.
I saw a swan for the first time at the park pond.

explain: '백조'는 한자로 '흰 새'라는 뜻을 가진 말이지만 보통 큰 물새를 가리켜요. 순우리말로는 '고니'라고 해요. 발레 '백조의 호수'로도 잘 알려져 있어요.
explain_en: The Hanja means 'white bird', but the word refers to a large water bird. The native Korean word is 고니. It is also well known from the ballet 'Swan Lake' (백조의 호수).

examples.en: A typhoon is moving north toward Korea.

examples.ko: 벚꽃 전선이 북상하면서 꽃이 피고 있어요.
examples.en: The cherry blossoms are opening as the bloom front moves north.
The rain clouds are moving north, so take an umbrella.
The heat is moving north, so Seoul will get hot too.
I saw news that the typhoon is moving north.

examples.ko: 장마 전선이 북상할 때는 비가 많이 와요.
examples.en: It rains a lot when the rainy-season front moves north.

explain: 태풍, 장마, 꽃 소식처럼 날씨와 자연이 북쪽으로 올라올 때 주로 일기예보와 뉴스에서 써요. 반대로 남쪽으로 내려오는 것은 '남하하다'라고 해요. 사람이 걸어서 북쪽으로 갈 때는 잘 쓰지 않아요.
explain_en: It is mainly used in weather forecasts and news when a typhoon, rainy front or blooming moves up to the north. Moving down south is '남하하다'. It is rarely used for a person walking north.

examples.en: The sea water temperature is warm, so it's good for swimming.
The water temperature suddenly dropped and the fish died.
Keeping the aquarium water temperature right is important.
The water temperature at the beach today is twenty degrees.
As the water temperature rose, jellyfish increased.

examples.ko: 수온을 재 보니 아기 목욕물로 알맞았어요.
examples.en: I measured the temperature and the water was right for the baby's bath.

explain: 바다, 강, 어항, 목욕물처럼 물의 온도를 말할 때 써요. 공기의 온도는 '기온', 몸의 온도는 '체온'이라서 '온'이 붙는 말이 여러 개 있어요. 뉴스에서 '수온이 오르다'는 날씨나 환경 기사에 자주 나와요.
explain_en: 수온 is the temperature of water, whether sea, river, aquarium or bath. Air temperature is 기온 and body temperature is 체온, so the 온 pattern covers several words. 수온이 오르다 shows up often in weather and environment news.

examples.ko: 올해는 비가 많이 와서 수확량이 줄었어요.
examples.en: It rained a lot this year, so the harvest was smaller.
After we changed the fertilizer, the yield went up.

examples.ko: 이 밭은 쌀 수확량이 다른 곳보다 많아요.
examples.en: This field has a bigger rice yield than other places.

examples.ko: 수확량을 늘리려고 농부들이 새 품종을 심어요.
examples.en: Farmers plant a new variety to increase the yield.

examples.ko: 올해는 날씨가 좋아서 수확량도 많을 것 같아요.
examples.en: The weather is good this year, so the harvest will probably be big too.

examples.ko: 사과 수확량이 해마다 달라서 가격도 변해요.
examples.en: The apple harvest differs every year, so the price changes too.

explain: 농산물 이야기에서 '수확량이 늘다/줄다', '수확량이 많다/적다'로 자주 써요. '생산량'은 공장 제품에도 쓰지만 '수확량'은 거둔 농작물에만 써요.
explain_en: In talk about crops it is often used as '수확량이 늘다/줄다' or '수확량이 많다/적다'. '생산량' can also refer to factory goods, but '수확량' is only for harvested crops.

examples.ko: 이 혜성은 칠십육 년마다 지구에 가까이 와요.
examples.en: This comet comes close to Earth every seventy-six years.
Last night I saw the comet's tail through a telescope.
The children were amazed looking at the comet photo.
There is an event at the observatory to watch a comet.
We might be able to see a comet tonight.

examples.ko: 그 신인 선수는 혜성처럼 나타나서 우승했어요.
examples.en: The rookie appeared like a comet and won the title.

explain: 혜성은 태양 둘레를 도는 천체이고, 뉴스에서는 '혜성처럼 등장하다'로 갑자기 나타나 주목받는 사람을 비유할 때도 써요. '살별'이라는 순우리말 이름도 있어요.

phrases.example: 그 가수는 혜성처럼 등장해서 인기를 얻었어요.
phrases.en: That singer burst onto the scene and became popular.
phrases.nuance_ko: 갑자기 나타나서 크게 주목받는 사람을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes someone who suddenly appears and gets a lot of attention.

explain_en: 혜성 is a comet, a body that orbits the sun. In the news, '혜성처럼 등장하다' describes a person who suddenly appears and gets attention. It also has a native Korean name, '살별'.
